description: This Java source file defines the class ResourceBinaryDictionary, which implements a static, compacted, binary dictionary for a keyboard application. It manages loading a binary dictionary resource, interfacing with native code via JNI to perform dictionary operations such as suggestions, validation, and retrieving loaded words.

classes.name: ResourceBinaryDictionary
classes.description: A class that loads and interacts with a native-implemented binary dictionary resource, providing suggestions, word validation, and resource management functionalities.

methods.name: ResourceBinaryDictionary
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dictionary with a resource ID and loads the native library.

methods.name: loadAllResources
methods.description: Loads dictionary resources, either from a raw resource or an array of resources, and initializes the native dictionary.

methods.name: loadDictionaryFromResource
methods.description: Reads resource files into a direct ByteBuffer and opens the native dictionary.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Provides word suggestions based on input codes, calling native methods and handling suggestion logic.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Checks if a given word is valid according to the native dictionary.

methods.name: closeAllResources
methods.description: Closes the native dictionary and releases resources.

methods.name: getLoadedWords
methods.description: Retrieves all loaded words from the dictionary via native callback.
